about.title: Mobilizing near neighbors
about.why: The believers best placed to reach an unreached people are usually the ones nearest to it in language and culture. This tool finds them for every unreached group, using Ralph D. Winter's E-scale and P-scale, so you can plan whom to mobilize, in which language, and where.
about.greenTitle: For churches: start from a green dot
about.green: Pick a reached (green) group, from the Reached groups list or a green dot, to see the unreached peoples its believers are best placed to reach, one E-level at a time, closest first. Then export the list (CSV), write a letter to its believers or print a prayer packet, for that church or its mission partners.
about.eTitle: E-scale: the distance a witness must cross
about.pTitle: P-scale: the distance between a people and a church
about.data: Reached means at least 2% evangelical (the IMB definition). Language and culture are judged from the language code and the IMB people taxonomy (cluster, affinity bloc, language family): good public proxies, not field assessments. Believer numbers are estimates from population and evangelical bands; use them to size an audience, not as counts.
about.source: People group data: peoplegroups.org (IMB), people_groups.csv. E-scale and P-scale: Ralph D. Winter, Lausanne Congress, 1974.

e.title1: E-1 · They speak the same language
e.long1: Believers who speak this group's language. They can share the gospel without crossing a language barrier, and a mobilization movement in this language can reach them.
e.long2: Believers from a related people: the same people cluster, or the same language family in the same affinity bloc. A shorter cultural step than starting from scratch.
e.long3: Believers living nearby (within 600 km or in the same country) whose culture is different. They share the region, not the language.
e.rlong1: Unreached groups who speak this group's language. Its believers can reach them without crossing a language barrier.
e.rlong2: Unreached groups from a related people: the same people cluster, or the same language family in the same affinity bloc.
e.rlong3: Unreached groups nearby (within 600 km or in the same country) whose culture is different.

p.title1: Believers in its own language exist
p.title2: The nearest believers are a near culture
p.title3: The nearest believers are a distant culture
p.long0: No reached group matched this people by language, culture or distance in this data.
p.long1: Somewhere, a reached group speaks this people's language. Mobilizing them is the most direct path.
p.long2: No reached group speaks this language, but related peoples have believers.
p.long3: Only believers of a different culture are nearby. Reaching this people needs cross-cultural workers.
